picks.title: Open-sourced UE Box — an AI agent that operates the Unreal Editor (levels, Blueprints, materials, C++)
picks.rationale: Open-source agent that operates the Unreal Editor (actors, Blueprints, materials, C++) with approval gates and change logs — directly actionable for game devs/tech artists.
picks.excerpt: Open-source UE Box AI agent operates the Unreal Editor directly — places actors, edits Blueprints, wires materials, fixes C++ errors.

picks.title: Atelier Ryza AI chatbot game developer to place restrictions on user inputs “to protect the integrity of the character and series” - AUTOMATON WEST
picks.rationale: Concrete AI-NPC design lesson: a shipped character-chat RPG adds input limits after prompt-injection misuse, with its 3-tier moderation stack described.
picks.excerpt: Spiral AI will restrict user inputs in RyzaChat:AI's October model update after prompt-injection misuse of the Ryza character AI.

picks.title: Voice actor Kenjiro Tsuda’s lawsuit over AI voice cloning dismissed, but ruling sets important precedent for protecting seiyuu voices in Japan - AUTOMATON WEST
picks.rationale: First Japanese ruling stating voices fall under publicity rights — sets the legal frame for AI voice cloning of game/anime voice actors.
picks.excerpt: Kenjiro Tsuda's AI voice-cloning suit vs TikTok dismissed, but Tokyo District Court rules voices are protected under publicity rights.

picks.title: Borderless Gaming's DLSS 5 Implementation Runs Without Touching NVIDIA's Software, Quantized to Work Well Even on Unsupported GPUs
picks.rationale: Borderless Gaming ships an installable, quantized DLSS 5-derived neural-rendering effect that runs without NVIDIA software on non-RTX-50 GPUs — a new tool, not another mod demo.
picks.excerpt: Borderless Gaming adds a quantized DLSS 5 neural rendering effect that runs without NVIDIA software, plus its own trained frame generation.

picks.title: Logitech
picks.rationale: Hands-on with Logitech G Hub Replay beta, a deep-learning auto-highlight clipper for 44 games — shows where AI clip selection still misses.
picks.excerpt: Logitech's beta Replay software uses deep learning to auto-pick and splice game highlight clips; PC Gamer tests it in Counter-Strike.
